newsitem.title: USA: Andover sets 20 pct stock div, payout.
newsitem.headline: Andover sets 20 pct stock div, payout.

text.p: Andover Bancorp Inc said on Thursday it would carry out a 20 percent stock dividend.
The company said in a statement that the dividend would be payable in the form of one share for each five shares of common stock outstanding to stockholders of record on Oct 28, 1996.

The company also will pay a quarterly cash dividend on its outstanding shares, including the shares distributed in the stock dividend, equal to $0.15 per share to stockholders of record on Oct 28, 1996.
The stock and cash dividends are both payable on Nov 13, 1996.

"Because of the additional shares outstanding after the stock dividend, the post-effective dividend of $0.15 reflects a 20 percent increase in quarterly dividends paid by the company," the statement said.
